title: Pilot failures mitigation, customer pathway, and hotpatch guidance
creator: Priya Singh
description: When a staged model pilot (soft-launch) shows regression signals in client traffic we need a clear containment and remediation path that preserves customer trust across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. This ticket captures the mitigation playbook, a customer-facing escalation pathway, and prescriptive hotpatch/runbook steps for on-call, release engineers, and account teams.
acceptance_criteria: A concise playbook exists for immediate containment that engineers can follow within 30 minutes of detection
Customer communication templates created for affected tiers (self-serve, enterprise with Dedicated, private installs)
A tested hotpatch process documented for Hosted and Dedicated with exact commands and rollback criteria
Private deployment guidance includes required artifacts for customer ops (migration bundle, patch checklist, post-deploy verification)
At least two run-through tabletop exercises completed with on-call and SEs and results captured
mitigation_playbook: Triage: Confirm regression signature (accuracy drop, hallucination pattern, latency spike, token inflation) and map to rollout cohort (pilot % / orgs affected)
Contain: For Hosted, suspend pilot flag and route traffic to previous stable model variant using routing policy 'pilot-fallback-v1'
Contain: For Dedicated, pause auto-rollout and pin serving nodes to previous model hash; disable new kernels if kernel scheduling suspected
Contain: For Private, instruct customer ops to revert to pinned model bundle and provide signed rollback artifact and steps; coordinate through AM
Mitigate: Enable prefix/KV cache bypass for suspect requests if regression tied to KV-cache population; observe for improvement
Mitigate: For classification/regression profile issues, switch to deterministic decoding config (top_p -> top_k=1) for affected routes while investigating
Hotpatch: If code-level fix needed in runtime, prepare a scoped hotpatch branch, run regression tests, and apply to Dedicated pools first for verification before Hosted-wide patch
Communication: Open an incident thread and activate customer escalation owners (SE for Dedicated/private customers, Support for self-serve)
runbook_steps: 0) Initial signal: Pager, slack #inc-ml-rollouts, or manual report. Owner: on-call runtime engineer
1) Snapshot: Capture failing request IDs, model hashes, serving node IDs, trace IDs and ingest into incident dashboard (link: https://redwood-internal/dashboards/rollout-incidents)
2) Verify: Reproduce regression against a recorded prompt set from the pilot cohort in a sandbox environment
3) Hosted fallback: POST /admin/routing/set with body '{"route": "pilot-route", "model": "stable-v2"}' and monitor tokens/sec and error rates for 15m
4) Dedicated pin: Run 'rdctl model pin --pool <POOL_ID> --model stable-v2 --reason "pilot regression"' and watch the dedicated pool dashboard until traffic stabilizes

5) Private guidance: Share rollback bundle: https://drive.redwood/internal/private-rollbacks/pilot-rollback-2026-03-10.tar.gz and checklist 'private-rollback-checklist.md' with the customer's on-prem operator; schedule hand-holding call

6) Hotpatch apply (if required): Create branch runtime/hotfix/33642, open PR to runtime repo, include changelog and test matrix, and merge with force-deploy tag; deploy to dedicated staging group first
7) Post-fix validation: Run the regression prompt set, measure accuracy delta, and confirm no token-latency regressions
8) Close loop: Update incident channel, notify affected customers with approved template, and create follow-up tickets for root cause work
customer_communication_templates: Self-serve template: Brief note acknowledging degraded outputs, action taken (pilot paused), expected timeline to restore (1–2 hours), and reassurance that no data exfiltration occurred
Enterprise/Dedicated template: Detailed summary with timeline, immediate mitigation steps taken, ETA for full rollback or patch, and offer of a technical call with the account SE
Private installs template: Step-by-step rollback instructions, signed binary/hash, checklist for customer's operator, and recommended verification queries to run post-rollback
postmortem_actions: Update model onboarding checklist to include a 48-hour shadow evaluation window for high-variance models
Add automated guardrails to detect sudden semantic shifts (embedding drift > threshold) and trigger automatic pilot suspension
Improve canary cohort size heuristics to include per-tenant anomaly detection for Dedicated customers
Instrument kernel selection telemetry to correlate model regressions with recent kernel changes
Deliver a cross-functional postmortem within 5 business days and capture customer outreach timeline
